integrity: A symbolic exact Cartier matrix and a characteristic-five chain proof establish every smooth parameter; an independent exact finite-field program tests all 24 smooth parameters in F25.
scientific_limitations: Applies only in characteristic five to smooth members of the given genus-six cyclic trigonal family.
No assertion about Newton polygons, full Ekedahl-Oort types, or all zero-p-rank curves.
Priority comparison cannot rule out inaccessible or differently parameterized historical Cartier matrices.
title: A zero-\(5\)-rank family with two Cartier strata among genus-six trigonal curves
